title: Air bass
description: Play a bass in the air: the fretting hand's distance along an imaginary neck picks the note (quantised to the scale), and a pluck of the other hand sounds it, predicted before the frame that shows it (packages/ictus/src/impact.ts). Off by default.

title: Air drum
description: Strike the air with a hand and hear a drum at the strike: each hand is a stick whose hit is predicted before the frame that shows it (packages/ictus/src/impact.ts). Off by default.

params.name: rightSound
params.type: enum(kick | snare | hihat | tom | crash | ride)

params.name: leftSound
params.type: enum(kick | snare | hihat | tom | crash | ride)

title: Air flute
description: Play a flute in the air: large finger lifts of both hands, enrolled per player and named by their note, choose the note; the player's enrolled blowing mouth (or a held fingering alone) sounds it as a sustained voice. Off by default.

title: Air guitar
description: Strum chords in the air: the fretting hand's shape is classified against the player's own enrolled chords, and a strum of the other hand, predicted before the frame that shows it, sounds that chord's guitar voicing. Off by default.

title: ASL Signs
description: Hands → ASL signs: the fingerspelled alphabet and a few common words, a score per sign (two small MLPs over the hand landmarks).

title: Body Feature Vector
description: Body pose landmarks -> a flat vector of enabled body catalog features (angles, segment directions, kinematics, shape, effort, relations); landmarks below minVisibility are masked.

title: Body Pulse
description: The dancer's pulse: the period, phase and confidence of the body's repeating movement (the stride by default), from ictus's octave-free pulse follower.

params.name: channel
params.type: enum(stride | head | hip | sway | yaw | trunk | auto)

title: Body Route
description: Routes catalog features (body first) to voice modulations — brightness, vibrato, pan, pitch bend, octave, gate, gain — per the body map.

inputs.name: bodyMap
inputs.description: Live routing config (the bodyMap dial)

title: Canvas Overlay
description: Mirrored video + composable overlay elements (guides, landmarks, markers, cues), and the elements extensions contribute.

title: Categorizer Chord
description: Your own hand-shape or pose categorizer (#450), read live: each of your categories plays a chord on the chord-source scale.

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

params.name: voicing
params.type: enum(spread | bassTriad | close | shell | power | voiceLed)

params.name: rendering
params.type: enum(sustained | strum | arpUp | arpDown | arpUpDown | pulse | alberti)

title: Category blend
description: Continuous control from a categorizer's memberships: each category's value, weighed by how much the player is in it, smoothed, to the chord's brightness or tension. Moving between two hand shapes or poses moves the sound between their settings.

title: Chord
description: Chord symbol (e.g. Cmaj7) → voiced synth params (one voice per chord tone).

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

title: Chord chart
description: Conduct a chord chart: the piece the conductor conducts, reduced to its chords beat by beat, walked by the conductor's beat; the chord in force sounds voice-led, its arpeggio stepping on his beats, holding through a fermata. Off by default.

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

params.name: voicing
params.type: enum(spread | bassTriad | close | shell | power | voiceLed)

params.name: rendering
params.type: enum(sustained | strum | arpUp | arpDown | arpUpDown | pulse | alberti)

title: Chord map
description: Play a key's chords by pointing at them: the seven diatonic chords laid out on the screen (by default a hexagonal map whose axes are moves by a fourth, a third and a second), the chord hand choosing one; it sounds while held, with a melody on its tones from the other hand, or is strummed by the other hand, predicted before the frame that shows the strum. Off by default.

params.name: melodySound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

params.name: voicing
params.type: enum(spread | bassTriad | close | shell | power | voiceLed)

params.name: rendering
params.type: enum(sustained | strum | arpUp | arpDown | arpUpDown | pulse | alberti)

title: Chord Select
description: Pick the first non-empty of a pool of chord-tone streams (the face chord, the pose chord, the sign chord, and any an extension declares), highest priority first, for the overlay.

title: Chord wheel
description: A next-chord wheel: the chord in force in the centre, one move per wedge at a fixed angle (the key's diatonic moves, or the Tonnetz's P, L, R and their compounds); push the hand toward a move and hold it, the wheel recentres on the new chord. Off by default.

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

params.name: voicing
params.type: enum(spread | bassTriad | close | shell | power | voiceLed)

params.name: rendering
params.type: enum(sustained | strum | arpUp | arpDown | arpUpDown | pulse | alberti)

title: Conductor
description: The beating hand (or, with source = body, the body) becomes musical time: ictus detection + a rhythm prior (packages/ictus/src; the oscillator-trend blend by default) → beat, bpm, dynamics for the score. Off by default.

outputs.name: leadsScore
outputs.description: Conducting the score (enabled, and not leading a recording): what the score and the orchestra play on

outputs.name: recordingTime
outputs.description: `time`, only while the conductor leads the recording (#187 PR 7): the song's pace controller follows it

outputs.name: level
outputs.description: The piece's beats per stroke (#376): 1 marking beats, 2 every other beat, the bar's beats marking bars

outputs.name: transport
outputs.description: The body's transport (#377): idle, armed, prepared, running, holding, stopped on a cut-off's frame, or off (reading the hands, or the rules off)

outputs.name: dance
outputs.description: A dancer leading (#380): waiting, locking, armed, following, switching or holding (absent otherwise)

title: Delay
description: Emit the input value from N ticks ago; nothing until that much history exists.

title: Drum out
description: Sounds the air drum hits on the audio clock at the time each was predicted for (WebAudio drums from primitives, no samples).

title: Expression Chord
description: Facial expression → a voiced, rendered diatonic chord on the chord-source scale (active only in face "chord" mode).

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

params.name: voicing
params.type: enum(spread | bassTriad | close | shell | power | voiceLed)

params.name: rendering
params.type: enum(sustained | strum | arpUp | arpDown | arpUpDown | pulse | alberti)

title: Face Categorizer
description: Your own face categorizer (#330), read live: the face to one of your categories, as the expression it stands in for. Passes the general model through until it is loaded.

title: Face Controls
description: Face frame → deliberate control axes (head yaw/pitch/roll, jaw-open, smile↔frown, brow-raise, lip-pucker), each with gain/deadzone/smoothing.

title: Face Expression
description: Face blendshapes → one of 7 emotions or neutral (per-class thresholds + neutral abstention, smoothing, enter/exit hysteresis, dwell).

title: Face Feature Vector
description: Face blendshapes + mesh + head pose -> a flat vector of enabled catalog features.

title: Face Features
description: Face blendshapes → normalized expression controls (smile, mouthOpen, brow, blink).

title: Gesture Classifier
description: Hand features → discrete poses (fist/open/pinch) + enter/exit edge events.

title: Hand Feature Vector
description: Hand image + world landmarks -> a flat vector of enabled per-hand + two-hand catalog features.

title: Hand Features
description: Landmarks → normalized per-hand position, openness, pinch.

inputs.name: handednessDwell
inputs.description: Live override of handednessDwellFrames (frames; 0 = raw label)

title: Hands (dwelled labels)
description: The hand stream with Left/Right held by the handedness dwell, for instruments that choose a hand by label.

inputs.name: handednessDwell
inputs.description: Live override of handednessDwellFrames (frames; 0 = raw label)

title: Indirect Map
description: Gesture features → weighted prompts + config dials (steers a generative engine).

inputs.name: steerConfig
inputs.description: Live override of strains/dials/smoothing/throttle; unset fields keep the param.

title: Keyboard Control
description: Keyboard key-press events → octave shift, magnetism, mute.

title: Keyboard Source
description: Global keyboard input → held / pressed / released key events.

title: Lyria Generative
description: Steers a generative engine (Lyria RealTime) from weighted prompts + config dials. Off by default; loads its SDK only when enabled, and needs a Gemini API key.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: The layer exists: load the engine and hold a session.

inputs.name: playing
inputs.description: The transport: stream audio while true.

inputs.name: volume
inputs.description: The generative bus gain 0..1.

title: MIDI Output
description: Sends the merged voices to a Web MIDI output as note-on/off + CC (WEBMIDI.js). Off by default; gracefully disabled where Web MIDI is unsupported (Safari/iOS).

title: One-Euro Filter
description: Adaptive jitter smoothing for a noisy control value (smooth at rest, responsive when fast).

title: Orchestra
description: The conducted score played by a sampled orchestra (spessasynth_lib + a cut MuseScore_General SF3): a pending-event scheduler on the conductor’s time, dynamics as CC11/CC74 on sounding notes. Off by default; loads only when switched on.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: The conductor’s musical time (beat, tempo).

inputs.name: velocityScale
inputs.description: The conductor’s dynamics, 0..1: CC11 + CC74 on every channel.

inputs.name: articulation
inputs.description: The conductor’s articulation, 0 legato .. 1 staccato: shortens the next notes.

inputs.name: conducting
inputs.description: The conductor is on: the orchestra plays.

inputs.name: doc
inputs.description: The loaded piece; none = the built-in demo scale.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: The conductor dial; its `orchestra` field switches the orchestra on and sets the levels.

inputs.name: claimed
inputs.description: A tool (the Trainer) has claimed silence.

title: Pace Controller
description: Makes the song follow the dancer: relates the dancer's pulse to the song's beat by an integer ratio and sets the song's rate (clamped around the player's tempo, nudged into phase, held when the dancer stops).

inputs.name: pulse
inputs.description: The dancer's pulse (body-pulse)

inputs.name: song
inputs.description: The song's beat at the playback position (song-player's songTime, a tick old)

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: The rate the song was played at (song-player's rate, a tick old)

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: The player's own tempo (the Song tool's slider): the centre of the clamp

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: How far from the player's tempo the song may be pulled, a fraction

inputs.name: lead
inputs.description: A conductor's time (#187 PR 7): while present, the song follows it beat for beat (the beat servo) instead of the dancer

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: The song's beat on which the conductor's first beat lands

inputs.name: songHandle
inputs.description: The loaded song (the store's handle): a new one restarts both laws (#439)

inputs.name: alignStart
inputs.description: The player's choice (the Song tool): after a Play, move the song ONCE so its beat lands on the dancer's cycle start, instead of closing the phase error through the rate nudge over several seconds (#346 item 1)

inputs.name: songStatus
inputs.description: The song player's status, a tick old: neither law leads a song that is not playable yet (#500)

outputs.name: rate
outputs.description: The rate to play the song at

outputs.name: pace
outputs.description: What the controller is doing: waiting, locking, following or holding, the ratio, the phase error

outputs.name: playing
outputs.description: The conductor's law: whether the song plays (paused while the conductor waits or holds)

outputs.name: cue
outputs.description: The conductor's law: the beat the song is moved to (a fresh id per request)

outputs.name: servo
outputs.description: The conductor's law: cueing, following or holding, the rate and the error in beats

title: Performance
description: Control signal → tempo (bpm) + dynamics (velocityScale), with optional humanization.

title: Pick
description: Extract a scalar from a structured input by dotted path (e.g. right.x).

title: Pluck out
description: Sounds plucked-string note events (the air bass) on the audio clock at the time each was predicted for (WebAudio plucks from primitives, no samples).

title: Pose Categorizer
description: Your own pose categorizer (#384), read live: the body to one of your saved poses, drawn on the video, and optionally the body conductor's start, hold and cut-off from your ready, fermata and cut-off poses.

title: Pose Chord
description: Head/face pose axes → a voiced, rendered diatonic chord (head-yaw→degree, pitch→octave, jaw-open→gate, smile→timbre, brow→7th). Active only in face "controls" mode.

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

params.name: voicing
params.type: enum(spread | bassTriad | close | shell | power | voiceLed)

params.name: rendering
params.type: enum(sustained | strum | arpUp | arpDown | arpUpDown | pulse | alberti)

title: Progression
description: Roman-numeral progression in a key + position (0..1) → current chord symbol.

title: Replay Body
description: Replays a recorded full-body pose stream, one frame per tick. Camera-free and deterministic.

outputs.name: body
outputs.description: The latest full-body pose frame (33 landmarks; absent when nobody is in frame).

title: Replay Hands
description: Replays a recorded hand-landmark stream, one frame per tick. Camera-free and deterministic.

title: Replay Source
description: Emits a recorded value stream, one value per tick.

title: Replay Source (timed)
description: Emits a recorded value stream by timestamp against ctx.time (hold-last, never interpolated), so a take replays at its own pace at any tick rate or clock speed.

title: Score
description: An immutable piece performed live: beat + velocityScale → the sounding synth voices. Plays a loaded ScoreDoc (MIDI / MusicXML) or the built-in demo scale.

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

title: Sign Chord
description: ASL letters A..G → the diatonic chord of the key whose root has that letter name (accidentals of the key applied), voiced and rendered like the face chords.

params.name: sound
params.type: enum(sine | triangle | square | sawtooth | warmPad | glass | bell | organ | voice | softLead | strings | flute | brass | choir)

params.name: voicing
params.type: enum(spread | bassTriad | close | shell | power | voiceLed)

params.name: rendering
params.type: enum(sustained | strum | arpUp | arpDown | arpUpDown | pulse | alberti)

title: Song Player
description: Plays the song loaded in the Song tool at a live rate with the pitch preserved, into the master bus, and publishes the song's beat as musical time.

inputs.name: song
inputs.description: The loaded song (the Song tool, through the store); absent = nothing to play

inputs.name: playing
inputs.description: The transport: song.play / song.pause

inputs.name: play
inputs.description: The press counter (song.play increments it): a change while `playing` is a press, so a Play made in the frame the song ends is not lost to a level that never fell (#344)

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Playback rate, pitch preserved (clamped to minRate..maxRate)

inputs.name: followRate
inputs.description: The pace controller's rate while the song follows the dancer (PR H); replaces `rate` when present

inputs.name: followPlaying
inputs.description: The conductor's transport (#187 PR 7): replaces `playing` when present (paused while the conductor waits or holds)

inputs.name: cue
inputs.description: Move the song to a beat (the conductor's cue): seeks whenever its id changes

inputs.name: holdFade
inputs.description: Seconds the song fades out on a conductor's hold and in on the release (#366); 0 = a cut

inputs.name: holdSlow
inputs.description: How far toward `minRate` the song slows during a conductor's hold fade-out (#573), a fraction (0 = the rate holds, as before); needs `holdFade` > 0. The rate eases back over the same length on the release

inputs.name: claimed
inputs.description: A tool holds the instrument quiet (the Trainer)

outputs.name: position
outputs.description: Seconds into the song, on its own timeline

outputs.name: rate
outputs.description: The rate the song is played at, after the clamp (what the pace controller reads back)

outputs.name: songTime
outputs.description: The song's beat at the playback position, tempo in engine time

title: UI Controls
description: Reads the live UI control store → scale + sound + overlay port values.

title: Synth Merge
description: Union the synth-params voice streams into one: a pool of instrument inputs (hushable; eight at least) and of score inputs (kept under hush; two at least); master mute. `unmuted` is the same stream before the master mute (for MIDI out).

title: Synthetic Body
description: Camera-free animated full-body skeleton (bounce / sway / arms / steps) for tests & demos.

outputs.name: body
outputs.description: The latest full-body pose frame (33 landmarks; absent when nobody is in frame).

title: Synthetic Hands
description: Camera-free animated hand landmark source for tests & demos.

title: Transport
description: Beat clock: integrates BPM over time into a running beat position.

title: Voice Mapping
description: Hand features → tonal synth parameters (x→pitch w/ scale snap, y→volume).

inputs.name: magnetism
inputs.description: Override magnetism 0..1

inputs.name: octaveShift
inputs.description: Transpose by N octaves

title: Web Audio Synth
description: Renders synth params to sound-preset voices (browser only).

title: Webcam Body
description: MediaPipe PoseLandmarker full-body pose (33 landmarks) from the shared webcam. Lazy-loaded, off by default.

outputs.name: body
outputs.description: The latest full-body pose frame (33 landmarks; absent when nobody is in frame).

title: Webcam Face
description: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker blendshapes from the shared webcam (lazy-loaded, off by default).

title: Webcam Hands
description: MediaPipe hand landmark detection from a webcam video element.
